Unescaped MediaFile attributes and CDATA terminators allow the advertiser to inject elements into VAST responses served for a publisher's zone. A crafted TrackingEvents block can suppress the ad server's video playback event records and redirect tracking requests to an attacker-controlled endpoint.

In Revive Adserver through 6.0.9, the zone banner-linking page (zone-include.php) does not cast the keys of the includebanner request array to integers. An authenticated manager, or a trafficker with the zone-linking permission, who owns the submitted website and zone can place SQL in an array key, which is concatenated unquoted into the banner-lookup query, resulting in time-based blind SQL injection bounded by the privileges of the application's database account.

In Revive Adserver through 6.0.9, an authenticated manager with access to two advertisers can associate a conversion tracker owned by one advertiser with a campaign owned by the other. The tracker-campaign page checks access to each object but does not verify that their actual owners match. The resulting association can expose the first advertiser's tracker name and identifier in the second advertiser's restricted conversion report.

In Revive Adserver through 6.0.9, an authenticated manager can supply another agency's advertiser or website identifier as a report scope and obtain that entity's name in an XLS report header. Submitted scope identifiers are not checked against the manager's permitted selections. The demonstrated disclosure is limited to entity names.

In Revive Adserver through 6.0.9, unauthenticated request parameters in ad delivery can cause reflected cross-site scripting. A crafted delivery URL places a macro token in the source or target parameter and malicious markup in the referer parameter. Macro replacement after initial input encoding can insert the unescaped markup into generated banner output, causing JavaScript execution in the delivery origin when a visitor follows the URL. An active banner is required.

In Revive Adserver through 6.0.9, user-controlled entity names in XLS report exports can be interpreted as spreadsheet formulas. A user with permission to rename a zone can place a formula in the zone name, which is then included in another user's Conversion Tracking report. Opening the affected spreadsheet can evaluate the formula and alter displayed report contents.

In Revive Adserver through 6.0.9, the zone-linking page can disclose campaign and banner names and identifiers belonging to another agency. An authenticated manager, or a website user with permission to link banners to zones, can supply another agency's advertiser and campaign identifiers because the selection lists are not restricted to the agency owning the zone.

In Revive Adserver through 6.0.9, deleting an agency, advertiser, or publisher through affected API paths can leave the associated account and user session active because the deletion path does not load the entity's account identifier before cleanup. A user whose entity has been deleted can continue accessing pages of the orphaned account. Access to data belonging to another agency was not demonstrated.
The summary service endpoint suffers from an IDOR vulnerability where it fails to verify user ownership of hardware serial numbers, exposing device data to scraping.
The production build of the M3WebServer hard-codes its backend API keys, which can be easily intercepted through verbose error handling pages.
The system fails to evaluate instructional permissions over multiple internal operation codes (opcodes), permitting unauthorized application installations or command executions.
Unchecked public access permissions on a core Broadcast Receiver allow unauthorized local software components to invoke administrative operations.
The ai_cmd utility executes with full root permissions. It pipes socket inputs directly to popen(), paving the way for unauthenticated users to execute arbitrary root commands.
The hard-coded APK resource files never expire, and the shared scepter leads to information leaks and potential misuse.

The local MQTT broker does not enforce topic-level Access Control Lists (ACLs). This allows any client to subscribe using wildcard characters (# or +) to enumerate hidden network devices or publish rogue control commands.
The FieldX MDM adb messaging topic passes unverified payloads directly into Runtime.exec(), allowing command/instruction injection.
Any connected WiFi client can fetch device info and meeting recording metadata without credentials.

Web administration panel (port 8080) binds to all network interfaces including public IPv6 addresses, making internal API endpoints reachable over WAN without firewall protection (related to CVE-2026-50224).

System service 'antaiuiserver' exposes transaction 14 (sendMyATCmd) & 4, allowing ANY app on device to send arbitrary AT commands to modem without permissions (no READ_PHONE_STATE, SEND_SMS). Enables reading IMEI, IMSI, ICCID, and managing SMS.
After authentication, /user/getNetworkStatus discloses SIM phone number, cell tower ID (enabling geolocation), and network type.
Admin password stored in plaintext at /data/data/com.acer.android.m3.webserver/shared_prefs/userInfo.xml, allowing any app with root or file access to read credentials directly.
Accessible without authentication via /user/resetPasswordFlagTest, forcing a password change prompt on the next admin login.
Any WiFi client can send HTTP DELETE to /meeting-recording/delete to permanently delete files without authentication.
Endpoints accessible without authentication from any WiFi client (e.g., /user/hasSimCard, /user/pooling, /api/device-info).

A SQL injection vulnerability exists in the Search Agents API of StellarOne due to improper sanitization of user-supplied input. An authenticated attacker with Viewer privileges can send crafted requests to manipulate backend SQL queries. This issue affects StellarOne: before 5.0.3232.

An improper authorization vulnerability exists in the patch management functionality of StellarOne. An attacker with Viewer web access can perform administrative patch management operations. This issue affects StellarOne: before 5.0.3232.

An arbitrary file write vulnerability exists in the patch upload functionality of StellarOne due to improper validation of file paths. An attacker with admin web access can upload a crafted patch package to write arbitrary files on endpoints with the privileges of the endpoint service. This issue affects StellarOne: before 5.0.3232.

An OS command injection vulnerability exists in the vShell command-line interface of StellarOne due to improper validation of user-supplied input. An authenticated attacker with access to vShell can inject crafted commands to bypass the restricted shell environment and execute arbitrary operating system commands. This issue affects StellarOne: before 5.0.3232.

A remote code execution vulnerability exists in the patch apply functionality of StellarProtect Linux and Stellar Agent (Linux) due to insufficient validation of uploaded patch packages before extraction. An attacker with low-privileged web access can upload a crafted patch package to execute arbitrary programs with root privileges on the server. This issue affects StellarProtect Linux: 1.0 and earlier; Stellar Agent (Linux): before 1.2.54. *Note: Stellar Agent (Linux) is the new name for StellarProtect Linux.

An improper version validation vulnerability exists in the product update mechanism of StellarProtect Linux and Stellar Agent (Linux). An attacker with product admin privileges can downgrade the product to an older, potentially vulnerable version, potentially allowing previously patched vulnerabilities to be reintroduced and security protections to be weakened. This issue affects StellarProtect Linux: 1.0 and earlier; Stellar Agent (Linux): before 1.2.54. *Note: Stellar Agent (Linux) is the new name for StellarProtect Linux.

A SQL injection vulnerability exists in an Accounts Manager service of StellarOne running inside a container due to improper handling of user-supplied input in SQL queries. An attacker with command execution access to the host system or another container with network connectivity to the affected service can send crafted requests to manipulate backend database queries. This issue affects StellarOne: before 5.0.3232.

An authenticated remote code execution vulnerability exists in the update functionality of StellarOne due to insufficient validation of files contained within uploaded update packages. An attacker with web administrator privileges can upload a crafted update package to execute arbitrary programs with root privileges on the server. This issue affects StellarOne: before 5.0.3232.

An HTML injection vulnerability exists in the alert notification functionality of StellarOne due to improper sanitization of agent-supplied data. An attacker controlling an agent identity can submit crafted HTML content, potentially allowing the attacker to manipulate displayed content or deceive recipients. This issue affects StellarOne: before 5.0.3232.

An authenticated remote code execution vulnerability exists in the firmware update functionality of StellarOne. An attacker with admin privileges can upload a crafted firmware package to execute arbitrary programs with root privileges on the system. This issue affects StellarOne: before 5.0.3232.

An improper access control vulnerability exists in a privileged Unix domain socket of StellarProtect Linux and Stellar Agent (Linux). Due to insufficient authorization checks, a low-privileged local attacker can interact with the daemon and invoke privileged operations without the necessary permissions. This issue affects StellarProtect Linux: 1.0 and earlier; Stellar Agent (Linux): before 1.2.54. *Note: Stellar Agent (Linux) is the new name for StellarProtect Linux.

ICU4C through 79.1 contains a use-after-free and double free vulnerability in the x11-compound-text converter because cloning shares the extraInfo block without a safeClone handler. Attackers who control the charset name passed to ucnv_open() in applications calling ucnv_setSubstString() or cloning converters can corrupt the heap, causing crashes and potentially code execution.

GNU mtools through 4.0.50 contains a divide-by-zero vulnerability that allows attackers to crash mtools commands by supplying a FAT image with a zero sectors-per-cluster byte. Attackers can craft a FAT image that, when opened with mdir, minfo or mtype, triggers a SIGFPE in calc_num_clus() on x86, causing denial of service.

A vulnerability was detected in mahmoudai1 school-management-system up to ecec9faaf2fb1a3c5cd096e063f8ef326d09cdfd. The impacted element is the function userModel::checkUserInDB of the file loginServer.php of the component Login Handler. Performing a manipulation of the argument ID results in sql injection. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

A vulnerability was identified in itsourcecode Insurance Management System 1.0. Affected by this issue is some unknown functionality of the file /deleteAgent.php. The manipulation of the argument agent_id leads to sql injection. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit is publicly available and might be used.

A security vulnerability has been detected in TOTOLINK N350RT 9.3.5u.6468_B20250827/9.3.5u.6466_B20250825. The affected element is the function setLanguageCfg of the file /cgi-bin/cstecgi.cgi. Such manipulation of the argument lang leads to authorization bypass. The attack can be executed remotely. The exploit has been disclosed publicly and may be used.

OpenAirInterface CN5G SMF through 2.2.2 contains a missing resource release vulnerability in handle_pdu_session_release_sm_context_request() that fails to delete N7 SM policy associations at the PCF. Authenticated UEs can repeatedly establish and release PDU sessions through the AMF-initiated Release SM Context path to accumulate stale associations and exhaust PCF memory.

GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in gf_odf_encode_ui_config() in src/odf/descriptors.c that allows attackers to crash the process. Attackers can persuade users to process a crafted XMT file declaring an interaction stream without a UIConfig descriptor, causing a denial of service.

GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the XMT scene loader that allows attackers to access freed heap memory by supplying a crafted XMT file. When xmt_parse_element() replaces an SFNode field child, the freed node stays cached in parser->peeked_nodes and a later DEF lookup passes it to gf_node_get_name(), crashing MP4Box.

GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in xmt_node_end() in src/scene_manager/loader_xmt.c that writes to freed heap memory when replacing single-node field commands. Attackers can persuade users to process a crafted XMT file where a Conditional node owning the command is unregistered, corrupting heap memory and crashing MP4Box.

Freedit before 0.9.9 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in the post_lock, post_hide, post_pin and comment_hide handlers that allows inn moderators to act on content from other inns. Attackers can supply their own inn id with a foreign post or comment id to lock or hide content instance-wide, or pin private posts to expose titles.

WeddingShare through 1.8.2 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the anonymous MediaViewerController.GalleryItem action that allows unauthenticated attackers to retrieve item upload paths without the gallery secret key. Attackers can enumerate sequential integer item ids to learn paths and uploader names, then download photos and videos from key-protected galleries served as static files.

GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains an uncontrolled recursion vulnerability in xmt_remove_od_links_recursive() in loader_xmt.c that lacks any depth limit when walking node children. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT file with deeply nested or cyclic node and SFCommandBuffer references to exhaust the stack and crash MP4Box on import.

GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability in the BT/XMT context loader that frees an interaction-type decoder-specific descriptor even when UIConfig re-encoding fails. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT scene with a BIFSConfig descriptor, causing gf_odf_delete_descriptor() to reuse and free it again, crashing MP4Box and corrupting heap memory.

GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a use-after-free vulnerability because xmt_find_node() in loader_xmt.c resolves DEF names without verifying the node belongs to the current scene graph. Attackers can craft an XMT scene reusing a PROTO node across graphs, causing gf_node_unregister() to read freed memory during teardown, crashing MP4Box and corrupting heap memory.

GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in gf_sg_command_apply() that allows attackers to crash the application via indexed field-replace commands lacking a payload. Attackers can craft an XMT scene whose GF_SG_XREPLACE command on an MFNode field carries no value, causing a crash and denial of service when opened.

GPAC MP4Box through 26.07.0 contains a heap use-after-free vulnerability in xmt_node_end() that leaves freed child node MFURL fields in the OD link list. Attackers can supply a crafted XMT file with an extra top-level SceneReplace node, causing xmt_resolve_od_links() to read freed memory, crashing MP4Box and corrupting the heap.

A flaw has been found in itsourcecode E-Logbook with Health Monitoring System 1.0. This affects an unknown function of the file log_keeper.php. This manipulation of the argument pid causes sql injection. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used.

A vulnerability was determined in wiroai Wiro-MCP up to 1.3.0. This affects the function upload_file of the file src/tools/upload-file.ts of the component File Upload. This manipulation of the argument url causes server-side request forgery. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. Upgrading to version 1.3.1 is able to mitigate this issue. Patch name: ac61f79888fd36fae8e282995847e542c4ef1cbd. It is recommended to upgrade the affected component.

A vulnerability was detected in Surya2Developer Online Shopping System 1.0. This impacts an unknown function of the file product.php of the component GET Parameter Handler. Performing a manipulation of the argument p results in sql injection. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit is now public and may be used. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

A vulnerability was identified in Skyvern-AI Skyvern 1.0.56. Impacted is the function classify_url of the file skyvern/forge/sdk/browser_egress_policy.py. The manipulation leads to server-side request forgery. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. Upgrading to version 1.0.57 is recommended to address this issue. The identifier of the patch is 10b8d829c2750ebf62f2b70dec0e288297e752dd. Upgrading the affected component is recommended.

A security flaw has been discovered in D-Link DIR-600L 2.17b02. This affects the function FUN_0040efb0 of the file gena.cgi of the component GENA Subscription Handler. Performing a manipulation of the argument service results in stack-based buffer overflow. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks.

SiYuan 3.6.0 before 3.6.2 and 3.7.3 before 3.8.10 contains a missing authorization vulnerability in the /api/block/getDOMText endpoint, which renders caller-supplied DOM without checking publish access for referenced image paths. When publish authentication is disabled, anonymous visitors can submit DOM referencing a known unpublished, non-encrypted asset path to retrieve its already-cached OCR text.

A weakness has been identified in Spotweb up to 1.5.8. This issue affects the function redirect of the file lib/SpotTemplateHelper.php of the component Login. Executing a manipulation of the argument http_referer can lead to open redirect. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks. This patch is called 0853d646d615225b35f466a960976d1492b786a9. Applying a patch is advised to resolve this issue.

Grav Form plugin 1.1.0 before 9.1.40 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability in Form::uploadFiles(), which sanitizes SVG only when a file's last extension is .svg and accepts markup under unrecognized extensions. Anonymous attackers can upload files like drawing.svg.foo through public any-type upload forms, running script in an administrator's session when opened, enabling super-admin creation on Grav 2.x with Admin2.

Admidio from 5.0.17 before 5.0.18 contains a missing authorization vulnerability that allows authenticated regular users to upload images into the announcements module by abusing the CKEditor upload handler. Attackers can send id=ann_description to ckeditor_upload_handler.php to store images under adm_my_files/announcements/images and retrieve them via show_image.php, abusing the application as an image host.

Admidio 5.0.0 before 5.0.18 contains an improper authorization vulnerability in modules/profile/profile_new.php that allows authenticated Group Leaders to bypass field-level profile restrictions. Attackers can request mode=html_selection to read restricted field values and submit mode=save requests to modify restricted member profile fields.

Vikunja from 0.19.0 before 2.8.0 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows authenticated users to exhaust CPU by supplying unbounded business-day operands in datemath filters. Attackers can send task or time-tracking filters like due_date > now+999999999999b, triggering a per-day loop in go-datemath that pins CPU cores and exhausts the server.

Vikunja from 0.19.0 before 2.8.0 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows authenticated CalDAV users to exhaust server CPU by uploading VTODO properties with many parameters. Attackers can PUT an iCalendar body with thousands of parameters on one line to any valid project ID, triggering superlinear parsing before permission checks.

Vikunja from 2.2.1 before 2.8.0 contains a TOTP replay protection bypass in ValidateTOTPPasscode that allows attackers to reuse consumed codes by padding them with whitespace. Attackers with valid credentials who observe a used passcode can resubmit it whitespace-padded to the login API within the validity window to obtain a session token.

Vikunja 0.17.0 before 2.8.0 builds the task.deleted notification and webhook payload, including related tasks, with the deleting user's permissions and sends it to all project subscribers without per-recipient authorization checks. A user subscribed to a project, or owning its webhook, receives full data of related tasks in private projects they cannot read when a task in their project is deleted.

PDF::API2 versions before 2.049 for Perl allow unbounded recursion via circular cross-reference chains in readxrtr.

When a PDF is opened, readxrtr reads each cross-reference table and calls itself on the offset in the trailer's /Prev entry. Nothing records which offsets it has already read, so a /Prev entry pointing back to an earlier table, or to its own, makes it recurse without end.

An attacker who supplies a crafted PDF can cause a denial of service in any application that opens it.

A vulnerability has been found in TAILG Feimeng up to 20261028. Affected is an unknown function of the component Wireless Remote Control System. The manipulation leads to authentication bypass by capture-replay. The attack needs to be initiated within the local network. The attack is considered to have high complexity. The exploitability is told to be difficult. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

A security vulnerability has been detected in Ghostty up to 1.3.1. The impacted element is an unknown function of the component macOS OSC 8 Hyperlink Handler. Such manipulation leads to injection. The attack can be launched remotely. Upgrading to version 1.4.0 is sufficient to resolve this issue. The name of the patch is 54fe8e188552977249a084db687e75aee6bf12e9. Upgrading the affected component is advised.

Grav Form plugin before 9.2.4 contains a code injection vulnerability that allows page authors to write uploads into Twig template folders by setting an unchecked file field destination in Form::uploadFiles(). Attackers can upload .txt or .svg files containing Twig and have them rendered as trusted templates outside the sandbox, executing code as the web server user.

Grav Admin plugin before 1.10.65 contains a password reset poisoning vulnerability in LoginController::taskForgot() that ignores the Require Trusted Host setting when building reset links. Unauthenticated attackers who know an administrator's username can submit the forgot-password form with a forged Host header, capturing the reset token when clicked to take over accounts.

wpa_supplicant 2.7 through 2.12 with the wolfSSL backend contains an EAP-FAST server authentication bypass in tls_sess_sec_cb() that skips master secret derivation for oversized PAC-Opaque tickets. Adjacent attackers running a rogue authenticator can complete the handshake with an all-zero master secret to capture MS-CHAPv2 responses for offline cracking and replace the stored PAC.

markdownify-mcp before 1.2.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows attackers to bypass URL validation by supplying DNS names, bracketed IPv6 literals, or IPv4-mapped IPv6 addresses. Attackers can influence URLs passed to webpage-to-markdown or git-repo-to-markdown through prompt injection to fetch loopback services, internal hosts, and cloud metadata endpoints.

Friendica through 2026.05-1 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in item_edit() that allows authenticated local users to edit other authors' posts by submitting their own stored copy's post_id. Attackers can POST to /item to delete attachments and overwrite the shared body, title and content warning, which is shown under the original author's name.

A weakness has been identified in nliautaud pico-content-editor up to 02d5ad6c820c5050c542ab9505819b5e0a0ba1af. The affected element is the function getLanguageContent of the file src/EditorsHandlers/ContentTools.php of the component ContentTools Editor. This manipulation of the argument ContentToolsUrl causes server-side request forgery. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been made available to the public and could be used for attacks. Continious delivery with rolling releases is used by this product. Therefore, no version details of affected nor updated releases are available. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way. This vulnerability only affects products that are no longer supported by the maintainer.

Kestra is an open-source control plane for workflows across data, infrastructure, and applications. Prior to version 2.0.1, the namespace-files export endpoint places an unvalidated namespace path segment into the Content-Disposition filename of the ZIP download. An attacker who tricks a user into following a crafted export URL can inject Content-Disposition header parameters to spoof the saved filename or extension. This issue is fixed in version 2.0.1.

The Custom User Registration Fields for WooCommerce plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Privilege Escalation in versions up to, and including, 2.2.3. This is due to the plugin accepting an attacker-controlled afreg_select_user_role value from the unauthenticated WooCommerce Store API /wc/store/v1/checkout request in the af_reg_checkout_data_to_order_meta_data_block() function, persisting it in order meta, and then passing it directly to WP_User::add_role() in the af_reg_custom_order_processing_function() function (hooked to woocommerce_thankyou) without validating against the plugin's admin-configured allowed role list. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to elevate their privileges to Administrator by creating an account during checkout with a modified JSON body specifying administrator (or any other role slug) as the desired role. Note: The exploit requires the "User Role Selection" setting to be enabled.
vp: custom user registration fields for woocommerce

cves.d: A security flaw has been discovered in msaifulcsse Ticket-Travel-Management-System 28b68cea41b3a9eb8d533db992e0b5ba2db68854/15c7bc0b48c263233326bb227fef01efc54c24a7. Impacted is an unknown function of the file bus1.php. The manipulation of the argument dfrom/gto/ddate/rdate results in sql injection. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been released to the public and may be used for attacks. This product takes the approach of rolling releases to provide continious delivery. Therefore, version details for affected and updated releases are not available. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

NetBird is a zero-trust networking platform that connects people, machines, and AI agents across any network. From versions 0.5.0 through 0.75.1, the client daemon exposes its gRPC control interface to any local process without authentication. On Linux, macOS, and FreeBSD, the interface is a Unix domain socket that is accessible to all local users, allowing any of them to control the daemon. An attacker with a low-privilege account can read or modify privileged VPN and daemon settings, disconnect or hijack the NetBird peer, and gain an unauthenticated root shell via the built-in SSH server. This issue is fixed in version 0.76.0.

A vulnerability was identified in philipjscott simple-thumbnail up to 1.6.5. This issue affects the function ffmpegExecute of the file index.js. The manipulation of the argument seek leads to os command injection. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit is publicly available and might be used. The project was informed of the problem early through an issue report but has not responded yet.

LightRAG provides simple and fast retrieval-augmented generation. Prior to 1.5.5, query responses are cached under a key that omits conversation_history, so an unauthenticated attacker can poison the cached answers returned to other users who send the same query. This issue is fixed in version 1.5.5.

Gogs is an open source self-hosted Git service. Prior to 0.15.0, Gogs does not regenerate the session ID after successful authentication. An attacker who forces a victim to use a known session ID can hijack the session after the victim logs in and take over the account. This issue is fixed in version 0.15.0.

A vulnerability was determined in FastStone Image Viewer up to 8.5. This vulnerability affects unknown code of the file FSViewer.exe of the component ICO Decoder. Executing a manipulation can lead to out-of-bounds write. The attack may be performed from remote. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

Improper Check for Unusual or Exceptional Conditions vulnerability in Drupal Drupal core allows Forceful Browsing. This issue affects Drupal core versions: from 0.0.0 to 10.6.23, from 11.0.0 to 11.3.23, from 11.4.0 to 11.4.14.

Improperly Controlled Modification of Dynamically-Determined Object Attributes vulnerability in Drupal Drupal core allows Object Injection. This issue affects Drupal core versions: from 0.0.0 to 10.6.22, from 11.0.0 to 11.3.22, from 11.4.0 to 11.4.13.

Missing Authentication for Critical Function vulnerability in Drupal Drupal core allows Exploiting Incorrectly Configured Access Control Security Levels. This issue affects Drupal core versions: from 0.0.0 to 10.6.22, from 11.0.0 to 11.3.22, from 11.4.0 to 11.4.13.

Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ("Cross-site Scripting") vulnerability in Drupal Data field allows Stored XSS. This issue affects Data field versions: from 0.0.0 to 2.0.15, from 3.0.0 to 3.0.1.
Missing Authorization vulnerability in Drupal File Resumable Upload allows Forceful Browsing. This issue affects File Resumable Upload versions: from 0.0.0 to 2.0.6.
Incorrect Authorization vulnerability in Drupal S3 File System CORS Upload allows Forceful Browsing. This issue affects S3 File System CORS Upload versions: from 0.0.0 to 1.4.0.
Improper Neutralization of Special Elements Used in a Template Engine vulnerability in Drupal Real Name allows Code Injection. This issue affects Real Name versions: from 0.0.0 to 2.0.1.

Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ("Cross-site Scripting") vulnerability in Drupal Layout Builder iFrame Modal allows Cross-Site Scripting (XSS). This issue affects Layout Builder iFrame Modal versions: from 0.0.0 to 1.3.9.

Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ("Cross-site Scripting") vulnerability in Drupal COOKiES Consent Management allows Cross-Site Scripting (XSS). This issue affects COOKiES Consent Management versions: from 0.0.0 to 1.2.17.
Incorrect Authorization vulnerability in Drupal Commerce sermepa allows Forceful Browsing. This issue affects Commerce sermepa versions: from 0.0.0 to 2.5.0.

Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ("Cross-site Scripting") vulnerability in Drupal Smart Trim allows Stored XSS. This issue affects Smart Trim versions: from 0.0.0 to 2.2.2, from 2.3.0 to 2.3.2.
Missing Authorization vulnerability in Drupal Download Count allows Forceful Browsing. This issue affects Download Count versions: from 0.0.0 to 2.2.5, from 3.0.0 to 3.0.2.
Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) vulnerability in Drupal Page Manager allows Cross Site Request Forgery. This issue affects Page Manager versions: from 0.0.0 to 4.1.0.
Insertion of Sensitive Information Into Sent Data vulnerability in Drupal Mollie for Drupal allows Forceful Browsing. This issue affects Mollie for Drupal versions: from 0.0.0 to 2.3.2.
Incorrect Authorization vulnerability in Drupal Mollie for Drupal allows Forceful Browsing. This issue affects Mollie for Drupal versions: from 0.0.0 to 2.3.2.
Insertion of Sensitive Information Into Sent Data vulnerability in Drupal Entity Print allows Forceful Browsing. This issue affects Entity Print versions: from 0.0.0 to 2.20.0.
Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) vulnerability in Drupal Campaign Monitor allows Cross Site Request Forgery. This issue affects Campaign Monitor versions: from 0.0.0 to 3.0.3.

Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ("Cross-site Scripting") vulnerability in Drupal Paragraphs entity embed allows Stored XSS. This issue affects Paragraphs entity embed versions: from 0.0.0 to 4.0.1.
Incorrect Authorization vulnerability in Drupal Commerce License allows Forceful Browsing. This issue affects Commerce License versions: from 0.0.0 to 3.1.2.
Incorrect Authorization vulnerability in Drupal Commerce License allows Forceful Browsing. This issue affects Commerce License versions: from 0.0.0 to 3.1.2.

Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel vulnerability in Drupal Authenticator Login Plus (2FA) allows Authentication Bypass. This issue affects Authenticator Login Plus (2FA) versions: from 0.0.0 to 1.0.3.

Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel vulnerability in Drupal Authenticator Login Plus (2FA) allows Authentication Bypass. This issue affects Authenticator Login Plus (2FA) versions: from 0.0.0 to 1.0.3.

Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel vulnerability in Drupal Authenticator Login Plus (2FA) allows Authentication Bypass. This issue affects Authenticator Login Plus (2FA) versions: from 0.0.0 to 1.0.3.

Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) vulnerability in Drupal Texts: key-based strings and translations allows Cross Site Request Forgery. This issue affects Texts: key-based strings and translations versions: from 1.0.13 to 1.0.17.

Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ("Cross-site Scripting") vulnerability in Drupal Texts: key-based strings and translations allows Stored XSS. This issue affects Texts: key-based strings and translations versions: from 0.0.0 to 1.0.17.
Missing Authorization vulnerability in Drupal Paragraphs Edit allows Forceful Browsing. This issue affects Paragraphs Edit versions: from 0.0.0 to 3.0.2.
Incorrect Authorization vulnerability in Drupal GraphQL Core Schema allows Forceful Browsing. This issue affects GraphQL Core Schema versions: from 0.0.0 to 1.0.29.

Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection') vulnerability in Drupal WordsOnline Connector allows SQL Injection. This issue affects WordsOnline Connector versions: from 2.0.0 to 2.0.6.
Privilege Defined With Unsafe Actions vulnerability in Drupal AdobeAnalytics allows Stored XSS. This issue affects AdobeAnalytics versions: from 0.0.0 to 1.1.0.
Insertion of Sensitive Information Into Sent Data vulnerability in Drupal Mime Mail allows Forceful Browsing. This issue affects Mime Mail versions: from 0.0.0 to 2.0.4.
Incorrect Authorization vulnerability in Drupal Islandora  allows Forceful Browsing. This issue affects Islandora  versions: from 0.0.0 to 2.19.1.

Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ("Cross-site Scripting") vulnerability in Drupal htmLawed allows Cross-Site Scripting (XSS). This issue affects htmLawed versions: from 3.0.0 to 3.9.0, from 4.0.0 to 4.1.8.

Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ("Cross-site Scripting") vulnerability in Drupal htmLawed allows Cross-Site Scripting (XSS). This issue affects htmLawed versions: from 4.1.0 to 4.1.11.

Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ("Cross-site Scripting") vulnerability in Drupal Extended HTML Filter allows Cross-Site Scripting (XSS). This issue affects Extended HTML Filter versions: from 0.0.0 to 1.0.4.
Incorrect Authorization vulnerability in Drupal Allowed Languages allows Forceful Browsing. This issue affects Allowed Languages versions: from 0.0.0 to 2.0.3.
Unverified Password Change vulnerability in Drupal Password Separate Form allows Functionality Bypass. This issue affects Password Separate Form versions: from 0.0.0 to 2.0.3.

Incorrect Authorization vulnerability in Drupal Scheduler allows Forceful Browsing. This issue affects Scheduler versions: from 0.0.0 to 1.7.0, from 2.2.0 to 2.2.3, from 0.0.0 to 2.0.*, from 0.0.0 to 2.1.*, from 2.3.0 to 2.3.1.
Incorrect Authorization vulnerability in Drupal Reset Password Email/SMS OTP allows Forceful Browsing. This issue affects Reset Password Email/SMS OTP versions: from 0.0.0 to 1.0.5.
Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ("Cross-site Scripting") vulnerability in Drupal Name Field allows Stored XSS. This issue affects Name Field versions: from 0.0.0 to 1.6.0.
Incorrect Authorization vulnerability in Drupal Forum Access allows Forceful Browsing. This issue affects Forum Access versions: from 0.0.0 to 2.0.3.
Improper Verification of Cryptographic Signature vulnerability in Drupal Commerce Escrow allows Signature Spoof. This issue affects Commerce Escrow versions: from 0.0.0 to 1.1.0.
Missing Authorization vulnerability in Drupal Commerce Product Alternative allows Forceful Browsing. This issue affects Commerce Product Alternative versions: from 0.0.0 to 1.0.1.

Improper Verification of Cryptographic Signature vulnerability in Drupal AlternativeCommerce PayPal Checkout allows Signature Spoof. This issue affects AlternativeCommerce PayPal Checkout versions: from 0.0.0 to 1.1.1.

Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ("Cross-site Scripting") vulnerability in Drupal Highlight Js syntax highlighter allows Reflected XSS. This issue affects Highlight Js syntax highlighter versions: from 0.0.0 to 1.3.1.

Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel vulnerability in Drupal REST & JSON API Authentication for Drupal allows Authentication Bypass. This issue affects REST & JSON API Authentication for Drupal versions: from 0.0.0 to 3.2.1.
vp: rest & json api authentication for drupal

cves.d: Missing Authorization vulnerability in Drupal Workflow Notifications allows Forceful Browsing. This issue affects Workflow Notifications versions: from 0.0.0 to 3.0.3.

Incorrect Authorization vulnerability in Drupal Simple OAuth (OAuth2) & OpenID Connect allows Forceful Browsing. This issue affects Simple OAuth (OAuth2) & OpenID Connect versions: from 0.0.0 to 5.2.6, from 6.0.0 to 6.0.10, from 6.1.0 to 6.1.4.
Missing Authorization vulnerability in Drupal S3 File System CORS Upload allows Forceful Browsing. This issue affects S3 File System CORS Upload versions: from 0.0.0 to 1.3.0.

Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ("Cross-site Scripting") vulnerability in Drupal Content Synchronizer allows Cross-Site Scripting (XSS). This issue affects Content Synchronizer versions: from 0.0.0 to 4.1.1.
Deserialization of Untrusted Data vulnerability in Drupal Content Synchronizer allows Object Injection. This issue affects Content Synchronizer versions: from 0.0.0 to 4.1.1.

GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 16.7.0 before 19.4.11, 19.5 before 19.5.9, and 19.6 before 19.6.2 that under certain conditions could have allowed an authenticated user with developer-role permissions to merge code changes into protected branches without triggering approval resets due to the use of a weak hash function in the merge request approval change detection mechanism.

A security vulnerability has been detected in GL.iNet GL-A1300, GL-AR300M, GL-AR300M16, GL-AX1800, GL-AXT1800, GL-B3000, GL-BE3600, GL-BE6500, GL-BE9300, GL-BE10000, GL-BE14000, GL-E750, GL-E750V2, GL-E5800, GL-MT300N-V2, GL-MT1300, GL-MT2500, GL-MT2500A, GL-MT3000, GL-MT3600BE, GL-MT5000, GL-MT6000, GL-SFT1200, GL-X300B, GL-X750, GL-X750V2, GL-X2000, GL-X3000, GL-XE300 and GL-XE3000. This vulnerability affects the function wg-client.set_config of the file /rpc of the component Management RPC. The manipulation leads to null pointer dereference. The attack can be initiated remotely. The affected component should be upgraded. This CVE was requested by the vendor.

A flaw was found in Submariner. In its default Pre-Shared Key (PSK) mode, all gateways within a broker set utilize the same PSK. An attacker, by knowing this shared PSK, can forge an Endpoint Custom Resource (CR) to impersonate another cluster's identity. This enables the attacker to establish an Internet Protocol Security (IPsec) tunnel under the false identity, leading to a Man-in-the-Middle (MITM) attack on network traffic between clusters.
vp: red hat advanced cluster management for kubernetes 2

cves.d: A weakness has been identified in GL.iNet GL-A1300, GL-AR300M, GL-AR300M16, GL-AX1800, GL-AXT1800, GL-B3000, GL-BE3600, GL-BE6500, GL-BE9300, GL-BE10000, GL-BE14000, GL-E750, GL-E750V2, GL-E5800, GL-MT300N-V2, GL-MT1300, GL-MT2500, GL-MT2500A, GL-MT3000, GL-MT3600BE, GL-MT5000, GL-MT6000, GL-SFT1200, GL-X300B, GL-X750, GL-X750V2, GL-X2000, GL-X3000, GL-XE300 and GL-XE3000. This affects the function wg-client.add_config of the file /rpc of the component Management RPC. Executing a manipulation can lead to null pointer dereference. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. You should upgrade the affected component. This CVE was requested by the vendor.

ai.summary_en: Today's curated vulnerabilities emphasize critical security gaps in cloud infrastructure, web services, and network equipment, where remote code execution and authentication bypasses represent the most prevalent attack methods. High-profile products including Keycloak, Traefik, and Samba suffer from flaws enabling credential forgery and command injection, while extensive memory corruption bugs in the Linux kernel and desktop components continue to drive local privilege escalation and denial-of-service conditions. Cloud environments face distinct dangers through container breakout vulnerabilities in LXD and Kubernetes ecosystems, alongside hypervisor weaknesses in VMware ESXi that risk full infrastructure takeover. The report also identifies significant risks in industrial control and IoT sectors stemming from hardcoded secrets and insufficient input validation, reflecting a broad trend of misconfigurations and logic errors across enterprise software.
ai.summary_zh: 今日精选漏洞凸显了云基础设施、Web服务和网络设备中的关键安全缺口，其中远程代码执行和身份验证绕过是最常见的攻击方式。Keycloak、Traefik和Samba等知名产品存在凭证伪造和命令注入缺陷；Linux内核及桌面组件中广泛存在的内存破坏漏洞持续导致本地权限提升和拒绝服务问题。云环境面临LXD和Kubernetes生态中的容器逃逸漏洞，以及VMware ESXi虚拟化层弱点带来的全面接管风险。报告还指出工业控制与物联网领域因硬编码密钥和输入验证不足引发的重大风险，反映出企业软件中配置错误与逻辑缺陷的普遍趋势。

items.reason_en: FreeRDP's missing authentication in shadow server fast-path input handlers allows unauthenticated attackers to inject keystrokes and mouse events before session activation, severely compromising remote desktop security.
items.reason_zh: FreeRDP 的阴影服务器快速路径输入处理程序缺少身份验证，允许未经身份验证的攻击者在会话激活前注入键盘和鼠标事件，严重损害远程桌面安全。

items.reason_en: Improper error handling in the X.Org Xserver X11 Present extension leaves dangling pointers that trigger use-after-free conditions during notification creation, potentially enabling local privilege escalation or system crashes.
items.reason_zh: X.Org Xserver X11 Present 扩展中的错误处理不当会留下悬空指针，在创建通知时触发释放后使用漏洞，可能导致本地权限提升或系统崩溃。

items.reason_en: GIMP's XMC plugin processes unvalidated comment subtypes as array indices, triggering out-of-bounds reads and use-after-free vulnerabilities that can crash the application or leak memory.
items.reason_zh: GIMP 的 XMC 插件将未经验证的注释子类型作为数组索引进行处理，触发越界读取和释放后使用漏洞，可能导致应用程序崩溃或内存泄露。

items.reason_en: A use-after-free flaw in the X.Org X server's fence triggering logic allows local attackers to destabilize the display environment or escalate privileges without user interaction.
items.reason_zh: X.Org X 服务器的栅栏触发逻辑中存在释放后使用漏洞，允许本地攻击者在无需用户交互的情况下导致显示环境不稳定或提升权限。

items.reason_en: The privileged gvfsd-admin daemon uses link-following chown() on user-controlled directories, enabling local privilege escalation through time-of-check-to-time-of-use race conditions.
items.reason_zh: 具有特权的 gvfsd-admin 守护进程对用户控制的目录使用跟随链接的 chown() 操作，通过检查与使用时竞争条件实现本地权限提升。

items.reason_en: Out-of-bounds heap write in the X.Org X server allows local attackers to crash the display server or potentially escalate privileges by manipulating DRI2 buffer attachments.
items.reason_zh: X.Org X 服务器中存在堆越界写入漏洞，本地攻击者可通过操纵 DRI2 缓冲区附件使显示服务器崩溃或潜在地提升权限。

items.reason_en: The vscode-java extension blindly trusts Markdown content in JavaDoc hovers, enabling attackers to execute hidden commands when developers interact with maliciously crafted source files.
items.reason_zh: vscode-java 扩展盲目信任 JavaDoc 悬停提示中的 Markdown 内容，当开发者与恶意构造的源文件交互时，攻击者可执行隐藏命令。

items.reason_en: Integer overflow in the X.org RandR extension's property change function allows client applications to bypass size checks, leading to memory corruption and potential graphical subsystem exploitation.
items.reason_zh: X.org RandR 扩展的属性更改函数中存在整数溢出漏洞，允许客户端应用程序绕过大小检查，导致内存损坏及潜在的图形子系统利用。

items.reason_en: Local unprivileged users can exploit a use-after-free in VMware guest 3D acceleration to crash the system or escalate privileges in desktop virtualization environments.
items.reason_zh: 本地非特权用户可利用 VMware 客户机 3D 加速中的释放后使用漏洞，在桌面虚拟化环境中导致系统崩溃或提升权限。

items.reason_en: Panorama Suite HMI desktop interfaces allow LDAP injection bypasses, compromising authentication and granting unauthorized access to business logic areas.
items.reason_zh: Panorama Suite HMI 桌面接口存在 LDAP 注入漏洞，可绕过身份验证机制，破坏认证安全性并授予对业务逻辑区域的未授权访问。

items.reason_en: Local privilege escalation via insufficient access controls in Acer's NitroSense service allows unauthorized registry modifications by authenticated users.
items.reason_zh: Acer NitroSense 服务中访问控制不足可导致本地权限提升，允许已认证用户进行未授权的注册表修改。

items.reason_en: Unhandled retryable TLS states cause an unbounded busy loop, enabling remote denial-of-service against enabled GNOME Remote Desktop VNC sessions.
items.reason_zh: 未处理的 TLS 重试状态会导致无界忙等待循环，从而对已启用的 GNOME Remote Desktop VNC 会话实施远程拒绝服务攻击。

items.reason_en: Improper handling of OSC 8 escape sequences in the terminal emulator allows remote attackers to inject malicious hyperlinks and manipulate terminal state.
items.reason_zh: 终端模拟器中 OSC 8 转义序列处理不当，允许远程攻击者注入恶意超链接并操纵终端状态。

items.reason_en: Frisbii Pay Android application embeds static API credentials in the APK, enabling attackers to forge requests and bypass authentication mechanisms.
items.reason_zh: Frisbii Pay Android 应用程序在 APK 中硬编码了静态 API 凭据，使攻击者能够伪造请求并绕过身份验证机制。

items.reason_en: Bizum Pay for Android hardcodes cryptographic signing values, allowing attackers to extract secrets and manipulate payment transactions without proper verification.
items.reason_zh: Bizum Pay Android 版硬编码了加密签名值，允许攻击者在缺乏适当验证的情况下提取密钥并篡改支付交易。

items.reason_en: The ai_cmd utility runs with root privileges and passes unsanitized socket data directly to popen(), enabling unauthenticated remote command execution.
items.reason_zh: ai_cmd 实用程序以 root 权限运行，并将未过滤的套接字数据直接传递给 popen()，从而导致未经身份验证的远程命令执行。

items.reason_en: Lack of topic-level ACLs in the local MQTT broker allows any client to subscribe via wildcards, facilitating network device enumeration and rogue command publication.
items.reason_zh: 本地 MQTT 代理缺乏主题级访问控制列表（ACL），允许任何客户端通过通配符订阅，从而便于网络设备枚举和恶意命令发布。

items.reason_en: A flaw in the rubyipmi gem used by Red Hat Satellite's BMC component allows authenticated attackers to craft malicious usernames that trigger remote code execution on baseboard management controllers, compromising hardware-level infrastructure access.
items.reason_zh: Red Hat Satellite 的 BMC 组件所使用的 rubyipmi gem 存在缺陷，允许已认证攻击者构造恶意用户名，从而在基板管理控制器上触发远程代码执行，危及硬件级基础设施访问权限。

items.reason_en: Critical authentication bypasses in Genetec Security Center's OIDC, SAML, and AD FS integrations directly compromise physical access control and surveillance infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: Genetec Security Center 的 OIDC、SAML 和 AD FS 集成中存在关键的身份验证绕过漏洞，直接破坏了物理访问控制和监控基础设施的安全。

items.reason_en: Trusting attacker-controlled length fields in LIVE555's Vorbis/Theora configuration parser triggers heap out-of-bounds reads, risking information leakage or denial of service in RTSP/NVR deployments.
items.reason_zh: LIVE555 的 Vorbis/Theora 配置解析器盲目信任攻击者控制的长度字段，会触发堆越界读取，在 RTSP/NVR 部署中可能导致信息泄露或拒绝服务。

items.reason_en: Exposed factory diagnostic interfaces on retail hardware grant malicious applications direct write access to critical NVRAM registers, compromising device integrity.
items.reason_zh: 零售硬件上暴露的出厂诊断接口允许恶意应用直接写入关键的 NVRAM 寄存器，破坏设备完整性。

items.reason_en: Maliciously triggered broadcast events can overwrite the device's MDM endpoint, effectively hijacking administrative control and shifting ownership to attackers.
items.reason_zh: 恶意触发的广播事件可覆盖设备的 MDM 端点，实质上劫持管理控制权并将所有权转移给攻击者。

items.reason_en: An overly permissive system service allows any installed application to send arbitrary AT commands to the baseband modem, exposing sensitive identifiers like IMEI and IMSI.
items.reason_zh: 权限过宽的系统服务允许任何已安装的应用向基带调制解调器发送任意 AT 指令，从而暴露 IMEI 和 IMSI 等敏感标识符。

items.reason_en: Canonical LXD's improper OIDC bearer token verification allows remote attackers holding valid identity provider tokens to authenticate to the LXD API, gaining unauthorized container control or user impersonation capabilities.
items.reason_zh: Canonical LXD 的 OIDC Bearer Token 验证不当，允许持有有效身份提供商令牌的远程攻击者向 LXD API 进行身份验证，从而获得未授权的容器控制权或用户冒充能力。

items.reason_en: LXD's recursive file pull feature suffers from improper link resolution on case-insensitive filesystems, enabling authenticated users to escape container boundaries and write arbitrary files to the host system.
items.reason_zh: LXD 的递归文件拉取功能在不区分大小写的文件系统上存在符号链接解析不当的问题，允许已认证用户突破容器边界并向宿主机系统写入任意文件。

items.reason_en: Unauthenticated access to OpenShift console devfile endpoints can be exploited for SSRF against internal cluster services, potentially exposing sensitive workloads.
items.reason_zh: 对 OpenShift 控制台 devfile 端点的未授权访问可被用于针对内部集群服务的 SSRF 攻击，可能导致敏感工作负载暴露。

items.reason_en: URL path manipulation in the cluster-proxy-addon bypasses authentication and authorization checks, granting unauthorized access to internal management routes.
items.reason_zh: cluster-proxy-addon 中的 URL 路径操纵可绕过身份验证和授权检查，授予对内部管理路由的未授权访问。

items.reason_en: Budibase's OIDC account linking flaw allows unauthenticated attackers to hijack global builder accounts by asserting email_verified=false at trusted identity providers.
items.reason_zh: Budibase 的 OIDC 账户关联缺陷允许未经身份验证的攻击者在受信任的身份提供商处声明 email_verified=false，从而劫持全局构建者账户。

items.reason_en: Path traversal via query parameters in the OpenShift console leaks sensitive pod filesystem files, including configuration secrets and deployment manifests.
items.reason_zh: OpenShift 控制台中通过查询参数实现的目录遍历漏洞会泄露敏感的 Pod 文件系统文件，包括配置密钥和部署清单。

items.reason_en: Missing cluster CA certificate and token validation in the Konnectivity proxy allows unauthenticated remote attackers to intercept or manipulate control plane traffic, compromising Kubernetes security.
items.reason_zh: Konnectivity 代理中缺失集群 CA 证书和令牌验证，允许未经身份验证的远程攻击者拦截或篡改控制平面流量，危及 Kubernetes 安全性。

items.reason_en: Argo CD's repo-server exposes an unauthenticated remote code execution vector that could allow attackers to deploy malicious applications directly into GitOps-managed clusters.
items.reason_zh: Argo CD 的 repo-server 暴露了一个未认证的远程代码执行途径，攻击者可借此将恶意应用直接部署至由 GitOps 管理的集群中。

items.reason_en: Namespace-scoped tenant administrators can exploit the ClusterCurator controller to mint privileged tokens, effectively escalating from namespace limits to full cluster administration.
items.reason_zh: 命名空间范围的租户管理员可利用 ClusterCurator 控制器签发特权令牌，从而有效突破命名空间限制，实现向完整集群管理权限的提升。

items.reason_en: Blind SSRF in the guardrails-detectors component enables remote attackers to exfiltrate sensitive cloud credentials and internal metadata by injecting crafted XML Schema strings.
items.reason_zh: guardrails-detectors 组件中的盲 SSRF 漏洞使远程攻击者能够通过注入构造的 XML Schema 字符串，窃取敏感云凭证和内部元数据。

items.reason_en: Podman Build race conditions enable container breakout and host filesystem enumeration, directly threatening containerized workload isolation.
items.reason_zh: Podman Build 的竞争条件可导致容器逃逸及主机文件系统枚举，直接威胁容器化工作负载的隔离性。

items.reason_en: cri-o directory traversal allows malicious containers to read and write arbitrary host files, breaking fundamental container security boundaries.
items.reason_zh: cri-o 的路径遍历漏洞允许恶意容器读取和写入任意主机文件，破坏了基础的容器安全边界。

items.reason_en: VMware ESXi I/O filter service use-after-free can lead to critical hypervisor compromise and virtual machine escape in cloud infrastructures.
items.reason_zh: VMware ESXi I/O filter 服务的释放后使用（UAF）漏洞可能导致关键虚拟机监控程序被攻破，并在云基础设施中引发虚拟机逃逸。

items.reason_en: Argo Workflows path traversal in artifact drivers allows attackers to overwrite sensitive files across connected cloud storage buckets.
items.reason_zh: Argo Workflows 工件驱动中的路径遍历漏洞允许攻击者覆盖已连接云存储桶中的敏感文件。

items.reason_en: An exposed JSON-RPC API permits unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary commands and exfiltrate secrets from isolated developer workspaces.
items.reason_zh: 暴露的 JSON-RPC API 允许未认证的攻击者执行任意命令，并从隔离的开发工作空间中窃取密钥信息。

items.reason_en: Flawed REST cookie parsing bypasses authentication checks, allowing unauthenticated attackers to gain administrative control over XCP-ng virtualization infrastructure.
items.reason_zh: 有缺陷的 REST Cookie 解析机制绕过了身份验证检查，使未认证的攻击者能够获取 XCP-ng 虚拟化基础设施的管理控制权。

items.reason_en: The unauthenticated local gRPC control interface enables local processes to manipulate zero-trust network configurations, risking lateral movement and policy bypass.
items.reason_zh: 未认证的本地 gRPC 控制接口允许本地进程操纵零信任网络配置，带来横向移动和策略绕过风险。

items.reason_en: CVSS 8.7 highlights a critical flaw in Submariner's default PSK configuration, enabling attackers to forge cluster identities and potentially hijack multi-cluster Kubernetes communications.
items.reason_zh: CVSS 评分 8.7 凸显了 Submariner 默认 PSK 配置的关键缺陷，攻击者可借此伪造集群身份，并可能劫持多集群 Kubernetes 通信。

items.reason_en: Samba's path traversal vulnerability in Unix domain socket pipe name processing allows attackers to write arbitrary files within private directories, potentially compromising SMB/CIFS services and associated RPC daemons.
items.reason_zh: Samba 在处理 Unix 域套接字管道名称时存在路径遍历漏洞，允许攻击者在私有目录内写入任意文件，进而可能危及 SMB/CIFS 服务及相关 RPC 守护进程。

items.reason_en: Corosync's membership commit token sanity check flaw allows unauthenticated remote attackers to trigger out-of-bounds reads via crafted UDP packets, causing cluster service crashes and denial of service.
items.reason_zh: Corosync 的成员提交令牌健全性检查缺陷允许未认证的远程攻击者通过构造的 UDP 数据包触发越界读取，导致集群服务崩溃及拒绝服务。

items.reason_en: Traefik's sanitizePath option fails to resolve dot-segments, allowing attackers to bypass router matching rules and apply unauthorized middlewares to traffic.
items.reason_zh: Traefik 的 sanitizePath 选项未能正确解析点号段，攻击者可借此绕过路由匹配规则，并向流量注入未授权的中间件。

items.reason_en: Netty's HttpServerCodec lacks read enforcement during HTTP pipelining, causing unbounded queue growth that exhausts heap memory and triggers service disruption.
items.reason_zh: Netty 的 HttpServerCodec 在 HTTP 流水线处理期间缺乏读取限制，导致队列无限增长并耗尽堆内存，进而引发服务中断。

items.reason_en: Corosync's Totem message reassembly omits runtime bounds checks in release builds, exposing multicast clustering protocols to heap corruption and potential remote code execution.
items.reason_zh: Corosync 的 Totem 消息重组在发布版本中省略了运行时边界检查，使组播集群协议面临堆损坏及潜在远程代码执行风险。

items.reason_en: Samba's printing subsystem passes unescaped job descriptions to shell commands, allowing remote attackers to achieve arbitrary command execution via specially crafted print requests.
items.reason_zh: Samba 打印子系统将未转义的任务描述传递给 Shell 命令，远程攻击者可通过特制的打印请求实现任意命令执行。

items.reason_en: Misconfigured password scripts using the %u substitution character pass unescaped usernames to shell contexts, granting remote attackers direct command execution capabilities on domain controllers.
items.reason_zh: 错误配置的密码脚本在使用 %u 替换符时会将未转义的用户名传入 Shell 上下文，赋予远程攻击者在域控制器上直接执行命令的能力。

items.reason_en: Missing SMB-layer access checks on NTFS-style reparse points allow authenticated users to bypass read-only share restrictions, enabling unauthorized metadata modification.
items.reason_zh: NTFS 风格重解析点在 SMB 层缺失访问检查，允许已认证用户绕过只读共享限制，从而实现未经授权的元数据修改。

items.reason_en: Linux kernel NVMe/TCP subsystem logical bug causes use-after-free, potentially permitting remote code execution on network-attached storage controllers.
items.reason_zh: Linux 内核 NVMe/TCP 子系统的逻辑缺陷会导致释放后使用漏洞，可能允许在网络附加存储控制器上执行远程代码。

items.reason_en: Linux kernel Netfilter use-after-free when adding chain rules allows local privilege escalation or system crashes in network filtering stacks.
items.reason_zh: Linux 内核 Netfilter 在添加链规则时存在释放后使用漏洞，可在网络过滤栈中导致本地提权或系统崩溃。

items.reason_en: VMware vmxnet3 NIC driver double-free vulnerability can crash the host system or escalate privileges in virtualized network environments.
items.reason_zh: VMware vmxnet3 网卡驱动的双释放漏洞可导致宿主机系统崩溃或在虚拟化网络环境中提升权限。

items.reason_en: Insufficient validation of the salt minion ID in the provisioning component allows remote attackers to achieve root-level command execution on network controllers.
items.reason_zh: 配置组件中对 Salt minion ID 的验证不足，允许远程攻击者在网络控制器上实现 Root 级命令执行。

items.reason_en: Unsanitized parameters in the conferencing component enable blind command injection, allowing unauthenticated attackers to fully compromise the underlying server.
items.reason_zh: 会议组件中存在未过滤的参数，可触发盲命令注入，使未认证的攻击者能够完全控制底层服务器。

items.reason_en: A remotely exploitable stack-based buffer overflow in the GENA subscription handler can lead to complete device compromise and network disruption.
items.reason_zh: GENA 订阅处理器中存在可远程利用的基于栈的缓冲区溢出漏洞，可能导致设备被完全接管及网络中断。

items.reason_en: Critical input validation flaws in the industrial controller allow authenticated attackers to execute arbitrary system commands, jeopardizing operational technology environments.
items.reason_zh: 工业控制器中存在关键输入验证缺陷，允许已认证的攻击者执行任意系统命令，危及运营技术环境。

items.reason_en: Weak authentication mechanisms in the industrial control series permit unauthorized access, potentially allowing attackers to manipulate critical manufacturing processes.
items.reason_zh: 工控系列产品的弱认证机制允许未授权访问，攻击者可能借此篡改关键制造流程。

items.reason_en: Keycloak's SAML HTTP-Redirect binding processes percent-encoded parameter names while signature verification checks literals, allowing attackers to forge responses and bypass authentication mechanisms entirely.
items.reason_zh: Keycloak 的 SAML HTTP-Redirect 绑定在处理百分号编码的参数名时，签名验证却检查原始字面量，攻击者可借此伪造响应并完全绕过身份验证机制。

items.reason_en: RESTEasy's CorsFilter misconfiguration reflects Origin headers alongside credentials when wildcard origins are permitted, facilitating cross-origin credential theft and malicious site interactions.
items.reason_zh: RESTEasy 的 CorsFilter 配置不当会在允许通配符源时将 Origin 头与凭据一同反射回响应中，助长跨域凭据窃取及恶意站点交互。

items.reason_en: Stored XSS in SiYuan allows attackers to inject DOM event handlers via shared Markdown files, enabling arbitrary script execution in victim browsers without interaction.
items.reason_zh: SiYuan 中存在存储型 XSS 漏洞，攻击者可通过共享的 Markdown 文件注入 DOM 事件处理器，无需交互即可在受害者浏览器中执行任意脚本。

items.reason_en: Budibase's broken object-level authorization lets authenticated users reference and modify other tenants' files, posing a severe risk of cross-tenant data exfiltration.
items.reason_zh: Budibase 的对象级授权缺陷允许已认证用户访问并修改其他租户的文件，存在严重的跨租户数据外泄风险。

items.reason_en: The WordPress Warehouse Cargo theme permits arbitrary file uploads via an unverified AJAX handler, allowing unauthenticated attackers to achieve remote code execution on vulnerable sites.
items.reason_zh: WordPress Warehouse Cargo 主题通过未经验证的 AJAX 处理器允许任意文件上传，致使未认证攻击者可在受影响站点上实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Traefik's ForwardAuth middleware fails to validate Proxy-Authorization headers alongside Authorization, enabling unauthenticated bypass of NTLM and Negotiate protections.
items.reason_zh: Traefik 的 ForwardAuth 中间件未能同步验证 Proxy-Authorization 与 Authorization 请求头，致使未认证攻击者可绕过 NTLM 和 Negotiate 身份验证机制。

items.reason_en: Missing file type validation in the WooCommerce Product Input Fields plugin permits unauthenticated attackers to upload arbitrary executable files, facilitating immediate web shell deployment.
items.reason_zh: WooCommerce Product Input Fields 插件缺失文件类型校验，允许未认证攻击者上传任意可执行文件，从而快速部署 Web Shell。

items.reason_en: A flawed non-empty guard condition in the WP Job Portal constructor bypasses authentication checks, allowing unauthenticated attackers to perform account takeovers and gain administrative access.
items.reason_zh: WP Job Portal 构造函数中存在缺陷的非空守卫条件绕过了身份验证检查，致使未认证攻击者可实施账户接管并获取管理员权限。

items.reason_en: Insecure deserialization of untrusted input in the PDF Invoice plugin enables unauthenticated PHP Object Injection, providing a direct path to remote code execution on vulnerable sites.
items.reason_zh: PDF Invoice 插件对不可信输入进行不安全的反序列化操作，导致未认证攻击者可发起 PHP 对象注入，进而直接在受影响站点上实现远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Generation of the site-wide signing secret using PHP's non-cryptographic uniqid() function severely weakens authentication mechanisms, leading to widespread privilege escalation across WordPress installations.
items.reason_zh: 使用 PHP 非密码学安全的 uniqid() 函数生成全局签名密钥，严重削弱了身份验证机制，导致 WordPress 实例中普遍发生权限提升。

items.reason_en: Undertow HTTP server fails to properly validate Host headers, enabling cache poisoning and authentication bypass attacks against web applications.
items.reason_zh: Undertow HTTP 服务器未能正确校验 Host 请求头，致使攻击者可对 Web 应用实施缓存投毒及身份验证绕过攻击。

items.reason_en: Keycloak redirect_uri validation flaw allows OAuth token theft and user impersonation across enterprise identity and access management systems.
items.reason_zh: Keycloak 的 redirect_uri 验证缺陷可导致企业身份与访问管理系统中的 OAuth 令牌窃取及用户冒充攻击。

items.reason_en: SEPPMAIL Secure Email Gateway suffers from pre-authentication SSTI, allowing unauthenticated attackers to disclose sensitive data and take over accounts.
items.reason_zh: SEPPMAIL Secure Email Gateway 存在认证前服务端模板注入（SSTI）漏洞，致使未认证攻击者可泄露敏感数据并接管账户。

items.reason_en: ChronoForms extension allows unauthenticated arbitrary file uploads due to flawed extension checks, leading to immediate remote code execution on web servers.
items.reason_zh: ChronoForms 扩展因校验逻辑缺陷允许未认证任意文件上传，致使 Web 服务器面临即时的远程代码执行风险。

items.reason_en: Unsanitized frontend filter parameters enable unauthenticated SQL injection, allowing attackers to extract or modify sensitive database records.
items.reason_zh: 前端过滤参数未经过清洗，导致未认证攻击者可发起 SQL 注入，从而提取或篡改敏感数据库记录。

items.reason_en: The unauthenticated Store API accepts manipulated role parameters, enabling privilege escalation attacks that grant unauthorized administrative access to WordPress sites.
items.reason_zh: 未认证的 Store API 接受被篡改的角色参数，致使攻击者可利用该缺陷实施权限提升，非法获取 WordPress 站点的管理员权限。

items.reason_en: Unchecked file upload destinations allow attackers to place malicious Twig templates in executable directories, resulting in arbitrary server-side code execution.
items.reason_zh: 文件上传路径缺乏校验，致使攻击者可将恶意 Twig 模板写入可执行目录，进而实现任意服务端代码执行。

items.reason_en: PostgreSQL extension scripts containing vulnerable quoting constructs are susceptible to SQL injection, allowing attackers with database access to execute arbitrary commands and exfiltrate sensitive data.
items.reason_zh: 包含不安全引号处理的 PostgreSQL 扩展脚本易受 SQL 注入攻击，致使拥有数据库访问权限的攻击者可执行任意命令并外泄敏感数据。

items.reason_en: 389 Directory Server's CleanAllRUV replication operation allows unauthenticated LDAP search filter injection, exploiting elevated replication privileges to manipulate directory state and bypass security controls.
items.reason_zh: 389 Directory Server 的 CleanAllRUV 复制操作允许未认证 LDAP 搜索过滤器注入，攻击者可利用高权限复制功能篡改目录状态并绕过安全管控。

items.reason_en: SurrealDB's JavaScript bridge bypasses query capability gates, allowing restricted subjects to execute arbitrary database commands and escape sandbox restrictions.
items.reason_zh: SurrealDB 的 JavaScript 桥接模块绕过了查询权限管控，致使受限用户可执行任意数据库命令并突破沙箱隔离限制。

items.reason_en: Netty's HTTP/1 to HTTP/2 conversion incorrectly prioritizes conflicting Host headers over absolute-form targets, facilitating request smuggling and cache poisoning attacks.
items.reason_zh: Netty 在 HTTP/1 至 HTTP/2 协议转换时错误地优先处理冲突的 Host 请求头而非绝对路径目标，致使攻击者可实施请求走私及缓存投毒攻击。

items.reason_en: Keycloak's client URI validation bypass enables registration of malicious redirect endpoints, which can be leveraged for credential phishing and session hijacking.
items.reason_zh: Keycloak 的客户端 URI 验证绕过漏洞允许注册恶意重定向端点，进而被用于凭证钓鱼与会话劫持攻击。

items.reason_en: 389 Directory Server's LDAP bind-rule evaluator incorrectly matches anonymous clients against empty stored attributes, granting unauthorized access to restricted directories.
items.reason_zh: 389 Directory Server 的 LDAP 绑定规则评估器错误地将匿名用户与空存储属性进行匹配，致使攻击者可越权访问受限目录。

items.reason_en: Stale Cyrus SASL auxiliary properties carry forward failed bind identities onto new connections, allowing attackers to bypass authentication mechanisms and impersonate other users in 389 Directory Server.
items.reason_zh: 389 Directory Server 中残留的 Cyrus SASL 辅助属性会将失败的绑定身份传递至新连接，致使攻击者可绕过身份验证机制并冒充其他用户。

items.reason_en: JBoss Marshalling deserializes cluster session replication data without class filtering, enabling unauthenticated remote attackers to execute arbitrary code via standard gadget chains.
items.reason_zh: JBoss Marshalling 在未进行类白名单过滤的情况下反序列化集群会话复制数据，致使未认证远程攻击者可利用标准 Gadget 链执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: The Picketlink SAML handler accepts unsolicited responses without proper validation, permitting attackers to forge assertions and authenticate as any principal with unrestricted roles.
items.reason_zh: Picketlink SAML 处理器未经验证即接受非预期响应，致使攻击者可伪造断言（Assertion）并伪装成任意主体以获取无限制角色权限。

items.reason_en: Second-order SQL injection in Hibernate's InlineIdsOrClauseBuilder allows low-privileged users to inject unsanitized characters into ID columns, extracting sensitive database contents.
items.reason_zh: Hibernate 的 InlineIdsOrClauseBuilder 存在二次 SQL 注入漏洞，低权限用户可将未过滤字符注入 ID 字段，从而窃取敏感数据库内容。

items.reason_en: PostgreSQL integer overflow during array modification permits authenticated users to execute arbitrary code within the database engine itself.
items.reason_zh: PostgreSQL 在处理数组修改时发生整数溢出，致使已认证攻击者可在数据库引擎内部执行任意代码。

items.reason_en: Eclipse Ditto executes untrusted JavaScript mapping scripts without sandboxing, enabling full Java object injection and remote code execution.
items.reason_zh: Eclipse Ditto 在未启用沙箱隔离的情况下执行不可信的 JavaScript 映射脚本，导致完整的 Java 对象注入及远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Unbound DNS resolver misconfigures default permissions, allowing local processes to tamper with runtime configuration and disrupt DNS resolution services.
items.reason_zh: Unbound DNS 解析器默认权限配置不当，致使本地进程可篡改运行时配置并干扰 DNS 解析服务。

items.reason_en: Failure to clear buffered plaintext during StartTLS negotiation enables on-path attackers to inject malicious LDAP commands after encryption is established.
items.reason_zh: StartTLS 协商过程中未能清空缓冲区内的明文数据，致使中间人攻击者可在加密通道建立后注入恶意 LDAP 命令。

items.reason_en: Inadequate permission scoping allows delegated administrators to overwrite security-sensitive Active Directory attributes, undermining directory integrity and access controls.
items.reason_zh: 权限作用域划分不当，致使委派管理员可覆写安全敏感的 Active Directory 属性，破坏目录完整性与访问控制策略。

items.reason_en: GCC's libstdc++ priority queue erase_if function fails to update internal pointers after reallocation, creating a use-after-free condition exploitable by applications relying on standard C++ libraries for memory corruption.
items.reason_zh: GCC libstdc++ 的优先级队列 erase_if 函数在内存重分配后未更新内部指针，引发释放后使用（Use-After-Free）漏洞，可被利用导致内存损坏。

items.reason_en: The Linux kernel's bdi_unregister race condition during disk removal schedules bandwidth estimation work after cleanup completes, leading to use-after-free scenarios that can crash the system or leak kernel memory.
items.reason_zh: Linux内核的bdi_unregister在磁盘移除期间存在竞态条件，会在清理完成后调度带宽估算工作，导致释放后使用场景，可能引发系统崩溃或内核内存泄漏。

items.reason_en: Inadequate validation of dynamic pointers in user-supplied eBPF programs allows attackers with CAP_BPF privileges to bypass safety checks and escalate to full system root access.
items.reason_zh: 对用户提供的eBPF程序中动态指针验证不足，使拥有CAP_BPF权限的攻击者能够绕过安全检查并提升权限至完整的系统root访问权限。

items.reason_en: KubeVirt's live migration proxy dials Unix sockets via /proc paths without symlink protection, creating a container escape risk during virtual machine migrations.
items.reason_zh: KubeVirt的实时迁移代理通过/proc路径连接Unix套接字且缺乏符号链接保护，在虚拟机迁移过程中存在容器逃逸风险。

items.reason_en: Crafting a malicious QEMU disk image with a json:{} block device descriptor triggers excessive resource consumption or code execution on the host system via the qemu-img utility.
items.reason_zh: 构造包含json:{}块设备描述符的恶意QEMU磁盘镜像，可通过qemu-img工具在宿主机上触发资源过度消耗或代码执行。

items.reason_en: llama.cpp RPC server contains an out-of-bounds write via zero-element tensors, allowing unauthenticated heap corruption and potential RCE in AI inference services.
items.reason_zh: llama.cpp RPC服务器存在通过零元素张量触发的越界写入漏洞，允许未授权堆损坏及AI推理服务中的潜在远程代码执行。

items.reason_en: Red Hat Tuned package allows unauthenticated local users to inject and execute arbitrary scripts via D-Bus, escalating to root privileges on the host.
items.reason_zh: Red Hat Tuned软件包允许未经认证的本地用户通过D-Bus注入并执行任意脚本，从而在宿主机上提升权限至root。

items.reason_en: Fence Agents Remediation operator exposes an RCE primitive through unsanitized SSH/telnet path arguments, impacting cluster management and orchestration workflows.
items.reason_zh: Fence Agents Remediation操作器因未过滤SSH/telnet路径参数而暴露出远程代码执行漏洞，影响集群管理与编排工作流。

items.reason_en: Eval injection in the framework's custom method dispatcher allows attackers to execute arbitrary code within the penetration testing environment, potentially compromising host systems.
items.reason_zh: 框架自定义方法分发器中存在Eval注入漏洞，攻击者可借此在渗透测试环境中执行任意代码，进而可能危及宿主机系统。

items.reason_en: Weak URL validation logic in the MCP tool enables SSRF attacks using obfuscated IP formats, facilitating unauthorized access to internal network resources.
items.reason_zh: MCP工具的URL验证逻辑薄弱，可利用混淆的IP格式发起SSRF攻击，从而获取内部网络资源的未授权访问权限。
